recommended.reason: measured on one Galaxy S26 with one binary (2026-09-02, 205-token prompt, 2 runs per cell): GPU 535-586 tok/s prefill / 23.3-23.7 decode against CPU 168-239 / 13.4-13.5; peak 951-1017 MB (GPU) vs 2394 MB (CPU). Same-device CPU control taken - a measured win. int8 is the card's recommended file (bf16-class on every gate); the int4 sibling decodes 17% faster on this GPU (27.4) at a 40% smaller download - a size option, not the default

measured on one Pixel 8a with one binary (S7 Android backfill 2026-09-07, 2 cold runs, 205-token prompt, cooled before each run): cpu 95.5-97.7 tok/s prefill / 8.55-9.5 decode, peak 2449 MB, engine init 9.4 s. The GPU path was not attempted on this 7.75 GB phone: a 1.5 GB int8 file at the Mali GPU's roughly 4x file-size residency would run at or past its memory budget (a 2.47 GB bundle OOM-rebooted this phone on 2026-08-17; the 0.48 GB granite-4.0-h-350m _int8_gpu file peaked at 4.3 GB on this GPU the same day as this row), so this is a verified choice, not a measured win. The CPU answered the probe correctly; the 205-token English prompt tokenizes to 321 tokens with this Japanese tokenizer. On the Galaxy S26 the flagship recommendation is gpu (1.7x, same-device pair of 2026-09-02); the int4 sibling was not measured on this phone

platform_notes: Tested on litert-lm 0.16.x (macOS CLI + python API, Android litert_lm_advanced_main v0.16.0 kit)

Embeds the HF tokenizer.json, not the vendor tokenizer.model: sarashina's SentencePiece model types every chat special (<|user|> <|assistant|> <|system|> </s>) as CONTROL, which a bare sentencepiece encoder never matches from text; engine-vs-HF ids identical on 7 probes
No start_token: add_bos_token is false and the official template emits no <s> (the 0.5b sibling measurably loses accuracy with one; the 1b is unmoved in bf16 but ships the same contract)
Structured prompt templates (<|user|>...</s>, <|assistant|>...</s>, <|system|>...</s>), stop id 2; KV budget 4096, 11 prefill signatures (1-1024)
Recommended file: bf16-class on every gate; 1.5 GB - peak resident memory 2.4 GB on the Android CPU path, 1.0 GB on the GPU path
